Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. is ₹ 341.61 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 641.58% and a 3-year CAGR of 847.97%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. is ₹ 349.50 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of -90.20%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. is approximately ₹ -373.18 Cr (based on an operating margin of -109.24%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. is 66.34. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. stands at 0.53. The interest coverage ratio is -8.58x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. is 126.61 (derived from a P/B ratio of 20.93 and market price of ₹ 2,650.60), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. is ₹ 659.16 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
